name: Nexthink-Async-MultiResponse-OptionE
description: Option E contact flow for the async multi-response pattern. Uses the Orchestrator AI Agent with MCP tools for polling — no custom loop logic in the flow. The flow sets up the environment and hands off to the Orchestrator.
notes: Contact Lens real-time analytics MUST be enabled before the Connect Assistant block — this is a platform requirement for AI agents on voice.
Nova Sonic Speech-to-Speech replaces the traditional STT → LLM → TTS pipeline. The voice is set to Generative speaking style.
All conversation logic (polling, response delivery, hold messaging, interruption handling) is managed by the Orchestrator AI Agent internally — the flow only sets up the environment.
The Get Customer Input block uses a Lex bot with AMAZON.QinConnectIntent, which enables the Orchestrator to take over the conversation.
This flow has ~6 blocks compared to 15+ for Option A's Lambda polling loop flow.

blocks.name: Set Recording & Analytics
blocks.description: Enables Contact Lens real-time analytics. REQUIRED for Connect AI agents on voice — must precede the Connect Assistant block.
blocks.notes: Without this block, the AI agent will not function on voice calls. This is a known platform requirement.

blocks.name: Set Voice — Nova Sonic Generative
blocks.description: Configures Nova Sonic Speech-to-Speech with Generative speaking style. Nova Sonic provides natural, expressive voice that adapts to caller tone and sentiment.
blocks.notes: Nova Sonic uses the StartConversation streaming API. Whether this bypasses the 10-second Lex voice timeout is unconfirmed and must be validated in prototyping.

blocks.name: Connect Assistant
blocks.description: Associates the AI agent assistant domain with the contact. Configures the Orchestration AI agent that will handle the conversation.
blocks.notes: The assistant domain ARN is configured at deployment time. The Orchestrator uses the custom prompt defined in orchestrator_prompt.yaml.

blocks.name: Get Customer Input — Lex with QinConnectIntent
blocks.description: Configured with a Lex bot that has AMAZON.QinConnectIntent enabled. This is where the Orchestrator takes over — the caller speaks, the Orchestrator reasons, invokes MCP tools, and speaks responses back via Nova Sonic. The GCI block only exits when the Orchestrator selects a terminal tool (COMPLETE, ESCALATION) or an error/timeout occurs.

timeoutBehavior.note: Nova Sonic streaming API may bypass the 10s limit — requires prototyping validation

blocks.notes: AMAZON.QinConnectIntent is the built-in intent that enables the Orchestrator AI agent to handle the conversation. The Orchestrator manages all polling, response delivery, and hold messaging internally.

blocks.name: Check Contact Attribute — Tool Routing
blocks.description: After the GCI block exits, the selected tool name is available as a Lex session attribute. Routes based on the terminal tool selected by the Orchestrator.

conditions.description: Orchestrator determined the interaction is complete.
Caller requested or Orchestrator determined a human agent is needed.

blocks.notes: The tool name is set by the Orchestrator when it decides to end the conversation. Unrecognized values fall through to the error handler.

blocks.name: Error Handler
blocks.description: Plays an error message when the Orchestrator encounters an unrecoverable error or timeout.

configuration.text: I'm sorry, we encountered an issue processing your request. Let me try again.

blocks.notes: In production, implement retry logic with a counter (e.g., max 2 retries) stored as a contact attribute to avoid infinite retry loops.

blocks.name: Transfer to Human Agent
blocks.description: Transfers the caller to a human agent queue when escalation is requested.

configuration.transferMessage: Let me connect you with a support agent who can help further.

flowSummary.comparisonToOptionA: Option A requires 15+ blocks with a custom polling loop, Lex interrupt bot, Play Prompt blocks, and Lambda invocations. Option E reduces this to ~8 blocks by delegating all conversation logic to the Orchestrator.
flowSummary.criticalRisk: The 10-second Lex voice timeout. If Nova Sonic's streaming API does not bypass this constraint, Option A becomes the primary path.
